delivery.notes: Postage: actual cost only, only when the requester asks for mailing or cannot receive in person, and at the lowest available mailing cost (MA-9007). Electronic delivery and facsimile: no copying fee may be assessed at all (32.07(2)(f), MA-9003). No handling/processing surcharge is authorized. Ele…

certification.notes: The Public Records Law fee scheme (c. 66 § 10(d); 950 CMR 32.07) contains no certification or certified-copy charge. 950 CMR 32.05(1)(d)1 acknowledges 'certified copies of records' only as a class the Supervisor may except from agency reporting — not a fee rule. av.notes: No A/V-specific schedule. commercial.notes: No commercial surcharge percentage or separate commercial schedule. fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: The fee for standard black-and-white paper copies or printouts shall not exceed 5 cents per page, for both single- and double-sided copies.

fee.labor_charge.summary: For a municipality, the hourly labor rate must equal or be less than the lowest-paid capable employee's rate and shall not exceed $25 per hour, unless a higher rate is approved by the Supervisor.
For a (state) agency, the hourly labor rate must equal or be less than the lowest-paid capable employee's rate and shall not be more than $25 per hour.

The Supervisor may approve a petition to charge for segregation/redaction time, or a municipal petition to charge over $25/hour, if the request is for a commercial purpose or the fee is a necessary, reasonable good-faith cost not designed to deter access; the entity must furnish the petition to t…
fee.labor_charge.clock_spec: Supervisor written determination within 5 business-days of receipt of the petition

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: A records access officer may assess a reasonable fee for production (except freely-inspectable records), and the fee shall not exceed the actual cost of reproducing the record.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: The actual cost of any storage device or material provided in response to a request may be included as part of the fee.

fee.free_allowance.summary: For a municipality with a population over 20,000, no labor fee may be assessed for the first 2 hours of work performed.
For a (state) agency, no labor fee may be assessed for the first 4 hours of work performed.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: A fee shall not be assessed for time spent segregating or redacting records unless such segregation/redaction is required by law or approved by the Supervisor.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: Each agency and municipality must designate one or more employees as records access officers to coordinate and respond to public-records requests.
In a municipality, the municipal clerk (or the clerk's designees, or any designee the chief executive officer appoints) serves as records access officer.

payment.advance_payment.summary: A records access officer may delay provision of records until all fees related to the request are paid in full by the person seeking access.
